# MarketingMN

> MarketingMN is a Minnesota marketing agency and growth partner for established businesses and organizations. The site covers strategic marketing, website strategy, SEO and demand generation, managed website systems, measurement, and company information.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://marketingmn.com/): Overview of MarketingMN's strategic marketing approach, capabilities, Minnesota focus, growth philosophy, and consultation offering.
- [Services](https://marketingmn.com/services/): Overview of strategic growth advisory, website strategy and digital experience, SEO and demand generation, and managed website systems.
- [Web Strategy](https://marketingmn.com/web-strategy/): Website strategy for service businesses in Minnesota, including information architecture, user experience, conversion paths, website development, SEO-focused migrations, and implementation.
- [SEO & Growth](https://marketingmn.com/seo-growth/): SEO, local search, content authority, search strategy, market intelligence, technical SEO, and demand generation focused on qualified visibility.
- [Managed Systems](https://marketingmn.com/managed-systems/): Managed website infrastructure covering hosting, proactive updates, security, backups, technical support, performance monitoring, SEO continuity, and ongoing improvement.
- [Results](https://marketingmn.com/results/): Marketing measurement framework covering strategic clarity, website performance, search visibility, local presence, lead quality, and digital infrastructure.
- [About](https://marketingmn.com/about/): Information about MarketingMN's Minnesota focus, experience, working principles, and approach to strategic marketing.
- [Contact](https://marketingmn.com/contact/): Contact and consultation information for organizations interested in working with MarketingMN.

## Policies and Accessibility

- [Privacy Policy](https://marketingmn.com/privacy/): Privacy information for visitors and users of the MarketingMN website.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://marketingmn.com/terms/): Terms governing use of the MarketingMN website and its content.
- [Accessibility](https://marketingmn.com/accessibility/): Accessibility information and the site's commitment to providing an accessible web experience.

## Primary Topics

MarketingMN focuses on:
- Minnesota marketing strategy
- Strategic growth advisory
- Website strategy
- Website design and development
- SEO and organic search
- Local SEO
- Search demand generation
- Content strategy and content authority
- Website management
- Website security and maintenance
- Digital infrastructure
- Marketing measurement
- Conversion-focused website strategy
- Service-business marketing

## Organization

MarketingMN serves established Minnesota businesses and organizations seeking a connected approach to strategy, websites, search visibility, content, technology, and growth.
